messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the autoscale postmortem  locking owners for remediation and a short rollout plan. please claim and ACK.

maya: ACTION ITEMS:
1) quota safety buffer -> set default project buffer to 12% + expose override (owner: ravi)
2) scheduler experiment -> run adaptive-packing trial start=0.66, min=0.60 (owner: sam)
3) headroom soak -> 48h soak with injected burstcases, capture eviction traces (owner: noa)
4) canary plan -> smoke 20m, soak 2h, full 6h with automated rollback hook (owner: ops-bot + maya)
5) runbook update -> add "post-surge checklist" + new alert for quota_pressure_rate>2/min (owner: maya)

maya: timeline: PRs by Wed EOD, sim Thu-Fri, canary next Mon; observe 5 business days post-rollout before closing.

ravi: taking quota buffer + API guard. will open PR with feature flag=false by default.

sam: taking scheduler perf sweep. will run cost/latency matrix and propose knobs.

noa: will run headroom soak. maya, please drop traces. i'll containerize the harness and upload artifacts to /sim-results.

maya: traces uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2026-03-autoscale-traces-v1.tar.lz4 (anonymized). noa ping when you start.

ops-bot: ci: quota-buffer PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4377 (author: ravi)

ravi: PR includes project_quota_min = max(requested, baseline*1.12) and integration tests. requesting infra review.

sam: perf sweep issue: https://go.redwood/scheduler-adaptive-910 \nparams: start_pack=[0.62,0.66,0.7], min_pack=[0.58,0.6], preempt_backoff_ms=[300,800], run=2h each. tagging eng-runtime.

noa: started 48h soak on dev-grid; streaming logs to /sim-results/3325000000-soak.tar.gz. initial 8h: buffer reduced transient evictions by ~70%, p99 uplift ~2.8% on heavy tails.

maya: proposed canary abort criteria: eviction_rate>1/min OR p99 uplift>10% OR quota_headroom_pct<5%.

ops-bot: canary-runner: scheduled canary cr-3325000000 on prod-canary-5 (stages: smoke->soak->full).

ops-bot: canary: smoke complete (20m)  no evictions, p99 +0.9%. proceeding to soak.

ops-bot: canary: full stage complete (6h)  result=PASS. metrics: eviction_rate=0, p99 +2.1%, cost_delta=+3.9%.

ravi: merging quota PR after 2 approvals. will enable feature-flag in canary only.

sam: perf sweep results posted in issue; recommend adaptive start=0.66, min=0.60 with cost_guard=6%.

noa: final soak report uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sim-reports/3325000000-final.pdf  tl;dr: 12% buffer + adaptive packing reduces eviction tail significantly while keeping p99 impact <3% in typical mixes.

maya: scheduling three weekly 15-min pulse checks (week1 ravi, week2 sam, week3 noa). if clean, i'll close the postmortem actions and update the runbook. ack?

ravi: ack.

sam: ack.

noa: ack.

maya: thanks all  will post closure ticket once observation window complete. :white_check_mark:
